status: Seek cancellation and fully bridged stream admission fixed in source; long Drive seek delays, universal format coverage and phone acceptance remain open.

input.source: Owner screenshot, later playback log, and clarification: seeking usually stops playback; screenshot error is a new variant.

phone_evidence.finding: Google Drive download proxy serves this movie, not an active Elementum stream; no private source URL/IDs retained.

3840x1608 HEVC 10-bit at 23.976 fps, advertised SDR. Third-party receiver gets 1920x804 H.264, VideoToolbox decode and GPU transfer. Conversions include 3782, 3526 and 2667 ms; a later converted request takes 4844 ms including request work.
Six-second CoreMedia timeouts; source/queue delays also affect copied media. Audio requests include 7007 and 8388 ms.
Prefetch converted segments are canceled around seeks.

Large seek to segment 521 (about 3126 seconds) has repeated requests waiting up to 26669 ms before session shutdown; final HTTP 500 reports session stopped. This log does not contain screenshot segment-37 foreground cancellation.

source_findings: Foreground conversions could cancel one another whenever a new request was far away; canceled output became HTTP 500 and a persistent error message.
Background ownership was cleared after unlocking its lane; a seeker could cancel a new foreground conversion under the stale background marker.
Speculative workers could acquire a lane ahead of queued foreground requests.
Expected prefetch cancellation compared an unprefixed string against video conversion: cancelled.
VP9+Opus (no copy-compatible track) was rejected by gm_stream_open before conversion bridges could run.
When a video needed conversion but no encoder was available, a session could succeed with audio only.
changes: Cancel only identified speculative conversion; preserve connected foreground requests. Clear background ownership before releasing its lane.
Prioritize queued foreground work over speculative work; initialization reads do not refocus speculative work to time zero.
Propagate a typed cancellation result to background workers; genuine read/decode/encode failures remain visible.
Log slow requests with separate lane-wait and production durations, without source URLs or titles.
Allow segment planning on decodable video when no copy-compatible track exists, retaining the no-copy marker so conversion is mandatory.
Reject unsupported video/absent encoder clearly instead of silently succeeding with audio only.

cancel_reproduction.baseline: Pre-fix kr_remux.c scheduler linked against the same harness/media and other current units, isolating server cancellation behavior.
cancel_reproduction.failure: Live overlapping converted request returns HTTP 500 and AirPlay conversion failed: video conversion: cancelled.
cancel_reproduction.fixed_behavior: Old request and forward target both return 200; backward seek and target retry remain usable, prefetch off/on; no fatal message.

actual_4k_fixture.checks: Original copy retains 4K dimensions. Converted output is actually 1920x1080; seeking to 18 s yields 12 decodable frames starting on a keyframe; backward seek succeeds.
actual_4k_fixture.limit: 6 fps bounds host fixture cost. This does not measure 23.976/60 fps, iPhone hardware, GPU or H.264 performance.

verification.host_encoder: MPEG-4 Part 2 test encoder through the same conversion pipeline; no iOS/H.264 encoder execution.

ffmpeg_host_source.source: FFmpeg GitHub n8.1.1 archive after official release-tarball host returned HTTP 503
ffmpeg_host_source.tag_signature: GitHub reports verified valid; not independently PGP-verified here.
ffmpeg_host_source.configuration: Repository host build flags; pinned release tarball hash was not verified because that download failed. No dependency configuration change committed.

validation_recovery: Initial native suite: 995 checks, one existing PQ fixture assertion failed. Generated frames lacked transfer metadata on this host; explicitly set frame color parameters and x265 VUI so the fixture is actually PQ.
Expanded native suite: 1048 checks, two failures including the fixture issue and real VP9+Opus admission failure. Fixed both; final suite: 1095 checks, zero failures.
An extra Python test command referenced nonexistent scripts/test_airplay.py; the actual relevant suite is test_airplay_remux (25 passing tests).

remaining: No claimed cause/resolution for all long Drive seeks: production includes source I/O, subtitle lookback, decoding and encoding. New queue/production diagnostics will narrow a later device capture.
Containers/codecs/HDR are separate constraints: AV1 decoding, some older containers/codecs, MP4 codec-aware fallback, proper HDR-to-SDR tone mapping and Dolby Vision remain gaps. See docs/AIRPLAY.md.

When a build is explicitly requested, build and publish a NEW KodiAirPlay release and verify/pin its checksum before the IPA. The existing r11 pin is unchanged and does not include these native source fixes.
Retest small/large/repeated forward/backward seeks on completed phone files, Drive copies and active Elementum input, with/without subtitles, and verify picture/audio/resume on the TV.
publication: Draft PR #8 only, skip CI, no merge; no universal every-file claim.
